column1: # The protected paths, read by protect-files.sh (Edit and Write) and block-dangerous-commands.sh (a
# shell write: a write verb's destination, a moved or deleted path, or a > redirect target). One row
#   scope     edit (the Edit/Write tools only), shell (shell writes only) or both
#   glob      lower-case, / separated, matched against the whole path and against any */ suffix of it
# Rows are read top to bottom and the first match decides, so a deny sits above any ask it overlaps.
# .git/ is edit-only: git itself and the documented hook activation write there through the shell.
# The secret, lock and generated rows are edit-only too: a shell read of a secret is already refused
# by the command guard, and a shell write to one was never guarded, so widening that is its own call.
